boundary: Changwon Special City (창원특례시) admin boundary, from OSM relation 7224484 via Nominatim: lat 35.0334 to 35.3943, lon 128.3479 to 128.8434. ko.wikipedia gives the area as 749.18 km2 and population at about 0.99M (5 gu). Nominatim puts the city point at City Hall (35.22796, 128.68186). Shape, west to east: (1) MASAN (마산합포구 + 마산회원구) wraps the narrow north-south inlet of 마산만 (Masan Bay). Downtown and the port are on its west shore (35.19-35.23, 128.56-128.58). The bay runs south past 돝섬 (35.1786, 128.5825) and under 마창대교 (35.1634, 128.595) into 진해만. 무학산 (761.4 m, 35.2111, 128.5358) walls Masan in on the west. Behind it, the large rural 마산합포구 hinterland (진동/진북/진전, centroid about 35.131, 128.488) runs SW to the 고성군 border, and the 구산면 peninsula reaches south to 저도 (35.067, 128.562). (2) The CHANGWON planned basin (성산구 + 의창구, grid laid out in the 1970s) sits in a flat bowl at roughly 35.19-35.26, 128.60-128.72. Mountains ring it: 천주산 638.8 m (35.2715, 128.5912) on the NW, 정병산 566.7 m (35.2632, 128.6923) and 비음산/대암산 (35.2069, 128.7294) on the NE/E toward 김해, 불모산 801.7 m (35.1677, 128.7405, the city's highest), and the 장복산 582 m ridge (35.1798, 128.6600) on the south. Long straight boulevards (창원대로, 중앙대로, 원이대로) cross the bowl. The 창원국가산업단지 industrial belt fills its southern half (bbox 35.184-35.232, 128.623-128.722). (3) NORTH 의창구 (북면, 동읍, 대산면) is rolling farmland and wetland (주남저수지 35.3148, 128.6727) that ends at the 낙동강 on the north edge (about 35.39), facing 밀양/김해. (4) JINHAE (진해구) is a coastal strip south of the 장복산/불모산 ridge on 진해만, reached by 안민터널 (35.1707, 128.7000) and the 장복/마진 tunnels. Its old town radiates from 중원로터리 (35.1494, 128.6597). It has a navy base and academy (35.1289, 128.6648), islands 음지도/우도/소쿠리섬 (about 35.08-35.09, 128.71-128.72), and 웅천/웅동 to the east. The Busan New Port container terminals sit on the eastern edge (about 35.077, 128.828) at the 부산 강서구 border. Neighbours: 함안군 (W/NW), 의령/창녕 across the 낙동강 (N), 밀양/김해시 (NE/E), 부산 (SE), 고성군 (SW). Sea: 남해 coast only (마산만 + 진해만), so the sea lies to the south and in the long inlet through Masan. A game map should treat it as three urban cores (Masan W, Changwon centre, Jinhae S) linked by ridge tunnels and the 마창대교 sea crossing.

districts.name: 의창구 (Uichang-gu)
districts.character: Center is 의창구청 (OSM way 470253872, Dogye-dong). Area 204.31 km2, pop about 218,589 (ko.wiki). Covers the northern half of the planned grid city: 경상남도청 (provincial capitol), 국립창원대학교 at the foot of 정병산, 창원역 and the KTX 창원중앙역, and the 도계동/명서동 apartments. North of 천주산/정병산 it opens into rural 북면 (마금산 hot-spring village, new 감계 town), 동읍 (주남저수지 bird wetlands) and 대산면 farmland along the 낙동강. Wikidata's geographic centroid is 35.306, 128.649. Gameplay: mostly calm, with long country roads, farm trucks and birdwatching.

districts.name: 성산구 (Seongsan-gu)
districts.character: Center is 성산구청 (OSM way 747487578, Namyang-dong). Area 89.06 km2, pop about 253,362. The city's civic and commercial core: 창원시청 and the giant 창원광장 roundabout, 용지호수, 성산아트홀, CECO, 창원종합운동장/스포츠파크, Lotte Dept Store and 상남동 neon nightlife. The roads are very wide, straight 1970s-planned boulevards (창원대로, 중앙대로, 원이대로) lined with trees. The southern half is the huge 창원국가산업단지 machinery and defense factory belt. The coast at 귀산동 has cafés under 마창대교. The district is closed in by 불모산 and 장복산, with tunnels to 김해 (창원터널) and 진해 (안민터널). Gameplay: traffic-heavy downtown, taxi and delivery hub, racing on long straights.

districts.name: 마산합포구 (Masanhappo-gu)
districts.character: Center is 마산합포구청 (OSM node 4655593841). Area 241.18 km2, pop about 180,600. Old Masan port downtown on the west shore of 마산만: 마산어시장 (since 1760), 부림시장, 창동 art alleys and 오동동 아구찜 street, with narrow streets and older low-rise buildings. Also includes the 마산항 piers and the 3·15해양누리공원 waterfront (국화축제), 경남대 on the 월영동 hillside, and 무학산 behind town. A large rural south-west runs through 진동/진전 and the 구산면 peninsula down to 저도 (콰이강의 다리 skywalk). Wikidata's geographic centroid is 35.131, 128.488. Gameplay: market shopping, ferries and coastal drives.

districts.name: 마산회원구 (Masanhoewon-gu)
districts.character: Center is 마산회원구청 (OSM node 5589516581, Sanho-dong). Area 90.58 km2, pop about 188,322. North Masan: dense apartments and the 양덕/석전/합성 neighbourhoods. Has 창원NC파크 (KBO NC Dinos), the 마산역 KTX/SRT hub, 3·15아트센터 and 팔용산 (stone-tower trail), with the 내서읍 suburbs further west toward 함안. Wikidata's geographic centroid is 35.229, 128.536. Gameplay: game nights at the ballpark, train arrivals, a dense bus grid.

districts.name: 진해구 (Jinhae-gu)
districts.character: Center is 진해구청 (OSM way 893270884, Jukgok-dong). Area 123.67 km2, pop about 193,762. Navy port town on 진해만 with a colonial-era radial street plan spreading from 중원로터리 (35.1494, 128.6597). It is Korea's cherry-blossom capital (진해군항제 at 여좌천, 경화역 and 제황산 진해탑). Also home to 해군사관학교 and the navy base, the 진해루/속천 seaside, and the island 해양공원 with the 136 m 솔라타워 on 음지도 plus 소쿠리섬. To the east are historic 웅천읍성 and the Busan New Port container terminals. Wikidata's geographic centroid is 35.1494, 128.6597, which is the old-town rotary. Gameplay: spring festival crowds, island hops, container trucking.

landmarks.name: 창원시청 (Changwon City Hall)
landmarks.footprint: Low-rise civic office block about 110x60 m on the north rim of 창원광장, with a forecourt, flagpoles and trees. Main building about 7 floors (height is an estimate). Address 중앙대로 151.
landmarks.description: Seat of the Changwon Special City government. Nominatim also returns the city's admin point here.
landmarks.activity: Civic job board and save point: pick up taxi, delivery and festival-helper side jobs; pay parking fines.
landmarks.source: OSM node 1904506976 via Nominatim (office=government 'Changwon City Hall')

landmarks.name: 창원광장 (Changwon Square roundabout)
landmarks.footprint: Huge circular rotary, about 210 m across (OSM bbox 35.2254-35.2273, 128.6810-128.6833), area 35,097 m2. Grass and tree island in the middle, multi-lane ring road, 6+ radial boulevards (중앙대로, 원이대로).
landmarks.description: One of Korea's largest roundabouts and the symbolic center of the planned city. City Hall sits on its north side, Lotte Dept Store on the south, 정우상가 on the west.
landmarks.activity: Racing checkpoint: timed laps of the giant roundabout. Festival stage and New Year events in the centre island.
landmarks.source: OSM way 704357897 via Nominatim; area from ko.wikipedia 창원광장

landmarks.name: 용지호수 (Yongji Lake, 용지공원)
landmarks.footprint: Irregular oval lake, area 54,600 m2, shoreline 1,169 m, depth 2.2-4 m. Sits inside 용지공원 (park bbox 35.2301-35.2349, 128.6774-128.6847, about 530x665 m) with a ring path, a music fountain and a wooden deck.
landmarks.description: Changwon's signature downtown lake park, between City Hall and the provincial office. The point is the park centroid; the lake fills most of the park.
landmarks.activity: Night music-fountain show, jogging-loop time trial, 누비자 bike dock pickup.
landmarks.source: Park polygon: OSM way 471366484 via Nominatim. Lake facts: ko.wikipedia 용지호수

landmarks.name: 경상남도청 (Gyeongsangnam-do Provincial Office)
landmarks.footprint: Broad symmetric 1980s government complex with a front lawn and plaza at the north-east end of 중앙대로. The 도의회 sits just east (35.2364, 128.6945) and the 경남경찰청 north-east (35.2374, 128.6936). Height is an estimate.
landmarks.description: Capitol of South Gyeongsang Province, at 중앙대로 300.
landmarks.activity: Start of the 중앙대로 boulevard cruise; photo spot; civic-quest giver.

landmarks.name: 창원NC파크 (Changwon NC Park)
landmarks.footprint: Open-air baseball park with an asymmetric bowl about 230 m across and 22,112 seats. Open outfield, big video board, Dinos navy-and-gold colours. Built on the old 마산종합운동장 site. Height is an estimate.
landmarks.description: Home of the KBO NC Dinos, at 삼호로 63.
landmarks.activity: Buy a ticket and watch an NC Dinos game: batting/catching minigame, mascot photo, fried-chicken stand.

landmarks.name: 창원종합운동장 (Changwon Sports Park main stadium)
landmarks.footprint: Oval athletics stadium with 27,085 seats (30,000 capacity), a 400 m 8-lane track and a 110x75 m pitch. Part of 창원스포츠파크, which also has the indoor 창원체육관 (LG Sakers basketball). Height is an estimate.
landmarks.description: Opened 1993; hosted the 1997 National Sports Festival and 2007 FIFA U-17 World Cup matches. Address 원이대로 450.
landmarks.activity: Track time trial or jogging; LG Sakers basketball at the adjacent gym.

landmarks.name: 성산아트홀 (Seongsan Art Hall)
landmarks.footprint: Modern concert-hall block with a stage fly tower, about 100x80 m, near the south-east edge of 용지공원.
landmarks.description: Changwon's main municipal performing-arts centre. The coordinate is approximate (±150 m), placed from the OSM '성산아트홀' bus stop at 35.22926, 128.68157 on 용지로.
landmarks.activity: Buy a concert or theatre ticket; evening event spawn point.
landmarks.source: OSM bus stop node 9355315235 named 성산아트홀 via Nominatim (approximate)

landmarks.name: 창원컨벤션센터 CECO (Changwon Exhibition Convention Center)
landmarks.footprint: Large exhibition hall complex about 200x245 m (OSM bbox 35.2377-35.2395, 128.6554-128.6581), with a glass atrium, flat roofs and a big forecourt. A hotel tower stands next to it. Height is an estimate.
landmarks.description: Convention and exhibition centre at 원이대로 362, 반지동.
landmarks.activity: Visit trade fairs; an indoor expo stall-hopping mission.

landmarks.name: 상남동 상업지구 (Sangnam-dong commercial district)
landmarks.footprint: Dense grid of 8-15 floor neon commercial blocks, about 600x500 m, around the 상남시장 building (about 140x155 m). Has a fountain plaza, food alleys and karaoke signs.
landmarks.description: Changwon's busiest nightlife and shopping district, just south-east of 창원광장. Wikidata places 상남동 at 35.21522, 128.68638.
landmarks.activity: Night district: karaoke, street food and arcade minigames. Busy taxi rank for late-night fare jobs.
landmarks.source: OSM way 472033870 '상남시장' (in 상남상업지구) via Nominatim; Wikidata Q12600418

landmarks.name: 창원중앙역 (Changwon Jungang Station)
landmarks.footprint: 2-storey modern station, 2,955 m2, with 2 island platforms and 4 tracks. Sits at the east edge of the city below 정병산, with a bus and taxi loop.
landmarks.description: KTX/경전선 station serving central Changwon.
landmarks.activity: Fast-travel KTX trips; taxi pickups of arriving passengers.

landmarks.name: 창원역 (Changwon Station)
landmarks.footprint: Elevated concourse station over the tracks (2 floors, 4,296 m2), 3 platforms and 5 tracks. Junction of the 경전선, 진해선 and 덕산선.
landmarks.description: Historic 1905 station at 의창대로 67, at the west end of the Changwon grid.
landmarks.activity: Board trains toward Masan, Jinhae (festival shuttle) or Busan; parcel delivery job.

landmarks.name: 마산역 (Masan Station)
landmarks.footprint: Main Masan station with 3 platforms and 6 tracks. 9,920 m2 front plaza with an 8 m floor fountain; largest railway yard in the province.
landmarks.description: KTX and SRT stop at 마산역광장로 18, 석전동.
landmarks.activity: KTX/SRT arrivals; taxi rank fares into old Masan.

landmarks.name: 진해역 (Jinhae Station)
landmarks.footprint: Small single-storey old station building on the 진해선 spur, with a short platform. About 400 m north of 중원로터리.
landmarks.description: Unstaffed halt at 충장로 71; regular passenger service is suspended and it is used mainly for the cherry festival.
landmarks.activity: Ride the cherry-festival shuttle train; start of the blossom walking quest.

landmarks.name: 경화역 벚꽃길 (Gyeonghwa Station cherry tunnel)
landmarks.footprint: Disused rural halt: a single track lined both sides by cherry trees for several hundred metres. Diesel loco 7212 and 새마을 coaches 10041/10042 are on display.
landmarks.description: Most photographed spot of 진해군항제; trains slow down through the blossom tunnel.
landmarks.activity: Cherry-blossom photo spot on the rails, posing with the display train.

landmarks.name: 여좌천 (Yeojwacheon stream, 로망스다리)
landmarks.footprint: Narrow concrete-banked stream about 1.5-2 km long running N-S (OSM segments 35.144-35.166 at lon about 128.658-128.661). Both banks are lined with cherry trees, with wooden decks and small footbridges (로망스다리) and night lights.
landmarks.description: Main blossom corridor of the 진해군항제.
landmarks.activity: Blossom walk photo quest at 로망스다리; spring night-light stroll.

landmarks.name: 제황산공원 & 진해탑 (Jehwangsan Park, Jinhae Tower)
landmarks.footprint: Small 90 m hill east of 중원로터리, crowned by a 9-storey, 28 m tower shaped like a warship mast (base about 400 m2). Has a monorail track and the 365-step 1년계단 stairway up the slope.
landmarks.description: Jinhae's symbol, with a lookout over the radial old town and the navy port. The point is an OSM park feature near the summit (approximate).
landmarks.activity: Ride the monorail up, then the tower lift to the observation deck for a city viewpoint and map reveal.
landmarks.source: OSM way 1367259426 'Jehwangsan Park' via Nominatim; height from 창원시설공단 cwsisul.or.kr and bada-on

landmarks.name: 중원로터리 (Jungwon Rotary)
landmarks.footprint: About 95 m traffic circle at the hub of 8 radial streets in Jinhae's old grid, with low 1-3 floor shophouses and cherry-lined avenues.
landmarks.description: Heart of Jinhae's colonial-era radial town plan and main 군항제 parade hub.
landmarks.activity: Watch the military-band parade during the festival; scenic taxi loop.

landmarks.name: 진해루 해변공원 (Jinhaeru seaside park)
landmarks.footprint: Traditional two-storey timber pavilion on a seaside promenade along a 1.4 km bay (OSM '진해루 바다' bbox 128.676-128.691). Grass lawns, seawall walk. Height is an estimate.
landmarks.description: Seaside park at 진희로 142, 경화동, next to the 속천 waterfront.
landmarks.activity: Sunset promenade walk, kite flying, fishing off the seawall.
landmarks.source: OSM way 469845517 via Nominatim; address from visitkorea/changwon.go.kr

landmarks.name: 속천항 (Sokcheon port)
landmarks.footprint: Small fishing and ferry harbour with breakwaters, a fish-sales hall (수협 직판장) and moored boats.
landmarks.description: Part of 진해항, opened 1968. The coordinate is approximate, placed between the OSM 속천동 node (35.14256, 128.66996) and the shoreline south of 속천로.
landmarks.activity: Buy fresh seafood at the co-op stalls; boat charter to the bay islands.
landmarks.source: OSM node 415145359 'Sokcheon-dong' and 속천로 way 202918330 via Nominatim; port description from 창원시 blog (approximate)

landmarks.name: 해군사관학교 (Republic of Korea Naval Academy)
landmarks.footprint: Waterfront military campus with a parade ground, piers and a full-size 거북선 (turtle ship) replica and museum. Mostly fenced.
landmarks.description: Korea's naval academy inside the Jinhae navy base; parts open to visitors during the cherry festival.
landmarks.activity: Festival-only guided base tour: board the turtle-ship replica and watch the navy ships.

landmarks.name: 창원해양공원 & 창원솔라타워 (Changwon Solar Tower)
landmarks.footprint: Slender 136 m solar-panel tower (600 kW, Korea's tallest solar building) rising from an exhibition podium on 음지도 island park. Joined to the mainland by a causeway; 명동로 62.
landmarks.description: Landmark of the 진해 해양공원 complex, with an observation deck.
landmarks.activity: Observation-deck viewpoint; zip-track ride over the water to 소쿠리섬.
landmarks.source: ko.wikipedia 창원솔라타워 (35.0902389, 128.7192028); height and kW from visitkorea access page

landmarks.name: 소쿠리섬 (Sokuri Island)
landmarks.footprint: Small wooded islet about 300 m long with a pebble beach. Sits just south-west of 음지도 and 우도. Height is an estimate.
landmarks.description: Island off 명동 reached by boat or zip-track from the marine park.
landmarks.activity: Zip-track landing; beach picnic; kayak circuit.

landmarks.name: 웅천읍성 (Ungcheon fortress town)
landmarks.footprint: Restored stone ring wall of a Joseon county town (walls about 4-5 m high) with a gate tower, in old 웅천 village. The 웅천왜성 ruins sit on a hill at 35.1068, 128.7578.
landmarks.description: Historic heart of 진해 웅천 (웅천동 centroid 35.10787, 128.73908).
landmarks.activity: History stamp walk around the walls and gate; photo quest.

landmarks.name: 부산항 신항 (Busan New Port, Jinhae side)
landmarks.footprint: Kilometre-long container quays with rows of about 80 m ship-to-shore gantry cranes and stacked container yards on reclaimed land. Height is an estimate.
landmarks.description: Korea's main container port, straddling the 진해구/부산 강서구 boundary. The Wikidata point is coarse; the 진해 terminals lie on the west side.
landmarks.activity: Container-truck delivery job: timed haul from the terminal to the 국가산단.

landmarks.name: 안민터널 (Anmin Tunnel)
landmarks.footprint: Twin-bore road tunnel running about 1.8 km N-S on the map (OSM bbox 35.1627-35.1787, 128.6983-128.7020) under the 장복산 ridge. Portals at 성산구 안민동 (N) and 진해구 석동 (S).
landmarks.description: Main road link from central Changwon to Jinhae.
landmarks.activity: Racing checkpoint on the 성산 to 진해 run; alternative scenic route over 안민고개 cherry road.

landmarks.name: 창원터널 (Changwon Tunnel)
landmarks.footprint: About 2.2-2.3 km E-W road tunnel (OSM bbox 128.7338-128.7584) through the 불모산 ridge. The west portal is in Changwon at about 128.734; the east portal is in 김해 장유.
landmarks.description: Main eastern exit of Changwon toward 김해/부산. The OSM centroid falls just inside 김해; use the west portal at about 128.734 for in-city placement.
landmarks.activity: Map-edge highway exit; commuter-traffic timed run.

landmarks.name: 장복산 (Jangboksan)
landmarks.footprint: Long forested ridge, peak about 582 m, separating the Changwon basin from Jinhae. Has a sculpture park and the 안민고개 hairpin road on its east shoulder.
landmarks.description: Ridge mountain with views over 진해만 and the navy port.
landmarks.activity: Hike to a viewpoint over 진해만; downhill drive on the 안민고개 cherry road.
landmarks.source: OSM peak node 10821227773 'JANGBOKSAN' via Nominatim; elevation commonly cited

landmarks.name: 불모산 (Bulmosan)
landmarks.footprint: Highest summit in Changwon (801.7 m) with broadcast masts on top. Broad forested massif on the 창원/진해/김해 border.
landmarks.description: Tallest mountain of the city; the 창원터널 passes under its northern flank.
landmarks.activity: Summit hike to the transmitter viewpoint for a full-map vista.
landmarks.source: Wikidata Q12599232; height from 경남도민일보 / Naver hiking guide

landmarks.name: 정병산 (Jeongbyeongsan)
landmarks.footprint: Rocky ridge, peak about 567 m, directly behind 창원대학교 and 창원중앙역. Ridge trail runs south to 비음산.
landmarks.description: Northern guardian mountain of the planned city.
landmarks.activity: Ridge hike 정병산 to 비음산 with a city-grid viewpoint.
landmarks.source: OSM peak node 1906091871 'JUNGBYEONGSAN' via Nominatim; elevation commonly cited

landmarks.name: 천주산 (Cheonjusan)
landmarks.footprint: Dome-shaped mountain, about 639 m, NW of the city, with azalea-covered upper slopes (용지봉). Splits the city from 북면.
landmarks.description: Famous for the April azalea festival.
landmarks.activity: Azalea-season hike to 용지봉 for a viewpoint over Masan and the Changwon basin.
landmarks.source: OSM peak node 1906091858 'CHEONJUSAN' via Nominatim; elevation commonly cited

landmarks.name: 무학산 (Muhaksan)
landmarks.footprint: Big crane-shaped mountain, 761.4 m, walling in Masan on the west. Long stair trails from downtown, azalea meadow 서마지기 near the top.
landmarks.description: Masan's guardian mountain, with views over 마산만 and 돝섬.
landmarks.activity: Sunrise summit hike with a 마산만 panorama viewpoint.

landmarks.name: 팔용산 (Palyongsan)
landmarks.footprint: Low hill (about 328 m) between Masan and Changwon, known for hundreds of hand-stacked stone towers (돌탑) along a valley trail.
landmarks.description: Neighbourhood mountain on the Masan to Changwon border.
landmarks.activity: Stone-tower trail walk; collectible stacked-stone markers.
landmarks.source: OSM peak node 10817156823 'PALYONGSAN' via Nominatim; elevation commonly cited

landmarks.name: 마창대교 (Machang Bridge)
landmarks.footprint: 1.7 km cable-stayed bridge, 20 m wide, 4 lanes. Two 164 m pylons with fan cables and 68 m clearance over the mouth of 마산만. Runs from 가포동 (W) to 귀산동 (E). Toll road.
landmarks.description: Opened 2008 on 국도 2/77. Cuts the trip from 16 km/35 min to 9 km/7 min.
landmarks.activity: Scenic toll-bridge drive; night-light photo; racing checkpoint between Masan and Changwon.

landmarks.name: 귀산동 카페거리 (Gwisan coastal café street)
landmarks.footprint: About 1 km seaside road with 2-3 floor glass cafés and pull-outs facing 마산만, right under the east end of 마창대교.
landmarks.description: Popular sunset and car-meet coast. The coordinate is approximate, between the OSM 귀산동 node (35.16582, 128.61499) and the bridge landing.
landmarks.activity: Sunset café stop; car-meet photo spot with the bridge backdrop.

landmarks.name: 돝섬 (Dotseom Island)
landmarks.footprint: Round islet of 112,000 m2, about 50 m high, in the middle of 마산만. Has a park, flower beds and a ferry pier on the north side.
landmarks.description: Island marine park about 10 minutes by hourly ferry from the 마산 passenger terminal.
landmarks.activity: Take the ferry to 돝섬, then a flower-garden photo hunt and island walking loop.
landmarks.source: Wikidata Q27275669 (old chart name 'Satow Island') at 35.17861, 128.5825; size and ferry facts from ko.wikipedia 돝섬해상유원지

landmarks.name: 마산항 (Masan Port)
landmarks.footprint: Piers 1-4 along the west shore of 마산만 with cargo sheds, harbour cranes, the ferry terminal and the new reclaimed island (마산해양신도시) offshore. Height is an estimate (cranes).
landmarks.description: Historic port opened in 1899; the 마산항해상교통관제센터 stands at 35.1949, 128.5733.
landmarks.activity: Harbour cargo delivery job; ferry boarding point.

landmarks.name: 3·15해양누리공원 (마산가고파국화축제장)
landmarks.footprint: About 1.9 km linear waterfront park (OSM bbox 35.1768-35.1943, 128.5633-128.5713) along the 마산항 quays, with lawns, a promenade and festival tents. Continues into 합포수변공원.
landmarks.description: Main site of the 마산가고파국화축제 chrysanthemum festival (26th edition: 2026-10-31 to 11-08), with giant chrysanthemum sculptures.
landmarks.activity: Chrysanthemum festival photo hunt; night market food stalls; waterfront 누비자 ride.
landmarks.source: OSM way 1015422811 '3.15해양누리공원' via Nominatim; festival dates from Naver blog / changwon.go.kr

landmarks.name: 마산어시장 (Masan Fish Market)
landmarks.footprint: Sprawling low-rise market district of about 190,000 m2 with about 2,020 stalls (1,320 fixed, 700 street) in covered alleys. Sits between 합포로 and the waterfront (동성동, 남성동, 신포동).
landmarks.description: Market since 1760, with 30,000-50,000 visitors a day and an autumn 전어 festival. The coordinate is approximate, offset seaward from the OSM '어시장' bus stop (35.20376, 128.57615).
landmarks.activity: Fish-market shopping minigame: haggle for 전어 and 아귀, then eat 아구찜 nearby in 오동동.
landmarks.source: OSM bus stop node 9355314913 '어시장' via Nominatim (approximate); facts from ko.wikipedia 마산어시장

landmarks.name: 부림시장 (Burim Market)
landmarks.footprint: Old covered traditional market block (clothes, fabrics, a food alley famous for 떡볶이) on 3·15대로, next to the 창동 alleys.
landmarks.description: Classic old-Masan market. The coordinate is the OSM '부림시장' bus stop at the market entrance (approximate).
landmarks.activity: Street-food alley tasting; outfit and fabric shopping.
landmarks.source: OSM bus stop node 9355315503 '부림시장' via Nominatim (approximate)

landmarks.name: 창동 예술촌 (Changdong Art Village)
landmarks.footprint: Maze of narrow alleys with 1-3 floor buildings, murals, artist studios and small galleries, about 200x200 m. Next to 부림시장.
landmarks.description: Revived old downtown art quarter of Masan. The point is the OSM 창동 neighbourhood node; the art village alleys lie within about 200 m.
landmarks.activity: Mural photo-collection walk; buy art prints; café stop.

landmarks.name: 3·15아트센터 (3.15 Art Center)
landmarks.footprint: Large modern performing-arts centre with a stage fly tower and a plaza, in 양덕동 near 창원NC파크.
landmarks.description: Masan's main theatre complex, named for the 1960 3·15 democracy uprising. The coordinate is approximate, from the OSM '3.15아트센터' bus stop (35.22677, 128.57709).
landmarks.activity: Buy a show ticket; night concert event.
landmarks.source: OSM bus stop node 9355316540 '3.15아트센터' via Nominatim (approximate)

landmarks.name: 경남대학교 (Kyungnam University)
landmarks.footprint: Terraced hillside campus in 월영동 overlooking 마산만, with 10+ mid-rise faculty buildings and a sports field.
landmarks.description: Major private university of Masan.
landmarks.activity: Campus tour; student food-delivery side job.

landmarks.name: 국립창원대학교 (Changwon National University)
landmarks.footprint: Large flat campus at the foot of 정병산, with grid-aligned mid-rise buildings, a stadium and tree-lined avenues. Near 창원중앙역.
landmarks.description: National university in 사림동.
landmarks.activity: Campus jog, then start of the 정병산 hike; student delivery job.

landmarks.name: 창원국가산업단지 (Changwon National Industrial Complex)
landmarks.footprint: About 5x9 km belt (OSM bbox 35.184-35.232, 128.623-128.722) of big-box machinery, defense and appliance factories, tank yards and wide truck roads in a strict grid. Lies south of 창원대로.
landmarks.description: Korea's flagship machinery industrial park, founded in the 1970s.
landmarks.activity: Freight truck delivery jobs; shift-change traffic event; forklift minigame.
landmarks.source: OSM relation 9794781 'Changwon Industrial Complex' via Nominatim

landmarks.name: 롯데백화점 창원점 (Lotte Department Store Changwon)
landmarks.footprint: Big boxy department-store block about 115x120 m (OSM bbox 35.2241-35.2251, 128.6812-128.6825) on the south side of 창원광장, with a glass entrance and rooftop. Height is an estimate.
landmarks.description: Main department store of central Changwon on 중앙대로.
landmarks.activity: Clothing and outfit shop; gift-shopping mission.
landmarks.source: OSM way 375651641 'LOTTE Department Changwon Store' via Nominatim

landmarks.name: 정우상가 (Jeongwoo Arcade)
landmarks.footprint: Mid-rise shopping arcade, about 5 floors, on 원이대로 at the west corner of 창원광장, with a busy bus stop in front.
landmarks.description: Classic Changwon meeting landmark ('meet at 정우상가').
landmarks.activity: Meet-up point for missions; BIS bus stop hub.

landmarks.name: 용호동 가로수길 (Yongho-dong Garosu-gil)
landmarks.footprint: About 1 km straight boulevard (용호로; OSM bbox 35.2302-35.2398, 128.6757-128.6851) under tall metasequoia trees planted from 1982 (about 25 m). Low cafés and restaurants on both sides.
landmarks.description: Changwon's tree-lined café street north of 용지호수. The coordinate is placed along the northern half of 용호로 (approximate).
landmarks.activity: Café-hopping; 누비자 bike ride under the metasequoias; autumn-foliage photo.
landmarks.source: OSM way 230799241 'Yongho-ro' via Nominatim; street description from 창원시 blog (approximate)

landmarks.name: 북면 마금산온천 (Bukmyeon Magumsan Hot Springs)
landmarks.footprint: Small hot-spring resort village with 4-8 floor spa hotels and bathhouses around a small valley below 마금산, in 북면.
landmarks.description: Changwon's hot-spring town (북면온천).
landmarks.activity: Hot-spring soak to rest and restore stamina; country-road drive.

landmarks.name: 저도 콰이강의 다리 (Jeodo Bridge / skywalk)
landmarks.footprint: Red-painted steel-truss footbridge, roughly 170 m long (approximate), joining 구산면 to 저도 island, with a glass-floor skywalk section. A newer road bridge runs alongside.
landmarks.description: Nicknamed 'Bridge on the River Kwai'; start of the 저도 비치로드 coastal trail.
landmarks.activity: Walk the glass skywalk; 저도 비치로드 coastal hike; romantic photo spot.

landmarks.name: 의창구 동읍 (Dong-eup town)
landmarks.footprint: Rural town centre with a 2-4 floor main street, a small station area and rice paddies all around. Gateway to 주남저수지.
landmarks.description: Farming town in north Changwon.
landmarks.activity: Farm-produce delivery job; country bus terminus.

landmarks.name: 주남저수지 (Junam Reservoir)
landmarks.footprint: About 602 ha of three linked reservoirs (산남, 주남, 동판) with reed islands and long earth embankment paths. Has an eco-learning centre (328 m2) and observation decks.
landmarks.description: One of Korea's largest migratory-bird wintering sites (swans, white-naped cranes, spoonbills from November to March).
landmarks.activity: Winter birdwatching photo mission; embankment bike loop.
landmarks.source: Wikidata Q12617322; facts from ko.wikipedia 주남저수지

landmarks.name: 주남돌다리 (Junam stone bridge)
landmarks.footprint: Short ancient slab-stone footbridge over a stream east of 주남저수지.
landmarks.description: Old stone bridge, a small heritage stop near the wetlands.
landmarks.activity: Heritage photo stamp on the 주남 bike loop.

signatureActivities: 진해군항제 cherry-blossom festival (late Mar to early Apr): photo spots at 여좌천 로망스다리 and the 경화역 rail tunnel, navy band parade at 중원로터리, festival shuttle trains
NC Dinos KBO baseball game at 창원NC파크 (22,112 seats); LG Sakers basketball at 창원체육관 in 창원스포츠파크
누비자 (Nubija) public bike rental: dock-to-dock rides on the planned city's long bike lanes (용지호수, 가로수길, 3·15해양누리공원)
City buses with BIS live-arrival boards on the 원이대로/창원대로 trunk corridors; bus hubs at 정우상가 and 창원광장
Taxi fare jobs: airport-style pickups at 창원중앙역/마산역 KTX, late-night 상남동 runs
Ferry to 돝섬 from the 마산 passenger terminal (about 10 min, hourly)
Toll drive over 마창대교 (164 m pylons, 68 m clearance) with a sunset stop at the 귀산동 café coast
Racing checkpoint routes: laps of the 창원광장 mega-roundabout, the dead-straight 창원대로, 안민터널/안민고개 hairpins to Jinhae, and the 마창대교 sea crossing
Fish-market shopping and haggling at 마산어시장 (autumn 전어), then 아구찜 dinner in 오동동
Mountain hikes with map-reveal viewpoints: 무학산 761 m, 천주산 azaleas in April, 불모산 801.7 m summit, 정병산 ridge, 장복산, 팔용산 stone towers
136 m 창원솔라타워 observation deck and a zip-track to 소쿠리섬 at the Jinhae marine park
저도 콰이강의 다리 glass skywalk and the 저도 비치로드 coastal trail
Monorail up 제황산 to the 진해탑 lookout over Jinhae's radial streets
용지호수 night music fountain and 용호동 가로수길 café-hopping
Freight and container delivery jobs between 창원국가산업단지 and 부산항 신항
KTX/SRT trips out of 창원중앙역 and 마산역 as fast-travel exits
